comment: Pedra formal glue catalog. Production kernel is the source; Verus file is a twin; callers must invoke the kernel. twin_kind: close = entry (or token_src) is an exec fn in the twin; atom = smaller fn (atom) only; model = same name, stand-in domain (e.g. u64 for &[u8]). status=absent is a recorded gap (script exists, twin file does not).
